# Blutech

> Blutech designs and delivers building AI and IoT hardware, software, integration and deployment for owners and property operations. Founded in Hong Kong in 2019, with an R&D office in Dongguan and an office in Qatar.

## Core proposition

- Accurate sensing, edge intelligence and connected building software.
- Blutech Halo is the daily workspace for owners and property teams: dashboards, floorplans, alerts, work orders, trends and reports.
- Blutech Core is the technical IoT platform: devices, gateways, data, rules, permissions, health and integrations.
- Bluetooth supports fast local edge control. LoRaWAN carries building data and settings. 4G, Ethernet or Wi-Fi gateways connect the system to Core.

## Confirmed scale and selected deployments

- More than 100 real-world deployments.
- Three Garden Road: 1,000+ connected devices, occupancy-led HVAC coordination, indoor air quality, water-leakage monitoring and ESG reporting integration.
- Metroplaza: 300+ connected devices and 180 connected cubicles, with occupancy and environmental signals supporting ventilation and HVAC operation.
- EMSD Headquarters: 230 connected cubicles across B1 to 6/F, including GWIN integration.
- Hong Kong International Airport: airport-wide passenger-safety monitoring using Heatmap sensing, floorplan visibility, alerts, dashboards and reporting.
- Hong Kong West Kowloon Station: passenger-facing and operator-facing smart washroom system including BT107 Smart Display, consumables, leakage, Heatmap, lighting and IAQ.
- Healthcare: non-camera patient-safety monitoring with local alarms, nurse notification, dashboards, LoRaWAN and Bluetooth.

## Selected hardware

- BT337 HeatMap Pro: low-resolution thermal occupancy and spatial sensing without conventional camera imagery; iF Design Award.
- BT306 Indoor Air Quality Sensor: temperature, humidity and PM2.5 monitoring; iF Design Award.
- BT102 Smart Info Station: architectural building-information interface; iF Design Award. Current model: BT102.
- BT101 Smart Signage: compact live facility information display; iF Design Award.
- Blutech Smart Lighting Control: local Bluetooth response with LoRaWAN data and 4G or IP backhaul.
- BT802 Indoor and BT803 Outdoor LoRaWAN Gateways connect field devices to Blutech Core.

## Accuracy
